title: Decision request: POST /v1/runtime/check (contract C3, spec 0.1)
description: What a client sends to have one action decided. It is runtime/gateway/internal/models.ActionRequest. The caller's identity for authorization is the credential on the request, never a field in this body.

resource.description: The resource in its canonical form, see spec/resource-model.md.

environment.description: The environment the action runs in ("dev", "production", ...).

agent_identity.description: The agent on whose behalf the action is taken (SDK callers). Must agree with the credential's subject.

metadata.description: Display context for a person who is asked about the request (the proxy sends proxy_context: query, body size and type, body_sha256, a redacted preview). It grants nothing and decides nothing.

nonce.description: Unique per request; a nonce seen again within the window is refused (replay protection).

issued_at.description: When the caller made the request; a stale one is refused.

min_epoch.description: The caller's minimum acceptable revocation epoch; a gateway whose view is older denies. 0 is unset.
